# General FAQ

## Order tracking

Customers can track any order from the account portal under Orders >
[order number] > Track Shipment. A tracking number is emailed automatically
once the order ships.

## Contacting Acme

Support is available by chat and email; there is no phone support. Typical
first-response time is under 4 business hours.

## Product line overview

Acme Widgets currently ships three product lines: the Standard Widget, the
Pro Widget (extended battery), and the Mini Widget (compact form factor).
All three share the same warranty and return policies described in the
billing and shipping sections of this knowledge base.
